references.text: Moses is tasked with gathering manna for the people of Israel, demonstrating God's provision of food for His people in the wilderness, parallel to Jesus' provision of food for the crowd.
Jesus feeds 5,000 men, plus women and children, with five loaves and two fish, showing a miracle of provision.
A similar miracle where Jesus feeds 5,000 men with five loaves and two fish.
Jesus performs a similar miracle by feeding 5,000 men with five barley loaves and two fish.
